A pale pink fibrillar stroma contains many scattered small dark-purple nuclei and larger paler spindle-cell nuclei in a loose, swirling arrangement. A denser smooth pink band (collagen- or muscle-like) occupies the lower left center and a small vessel-like profile lies at the lower left. No panel text is printed in the image itself; "left" follows the caption. Higher-power field (caption: right, 40×): Brightfield microscopy at higher magnification. At the left a cluster of cells with dark purple nuclei and red-tinged granular cytoplasm lies in pale pink stroma. A pink collagenous band crosses the upper center. At the right, spindle cells are layered in concentric rings around a central pale-pink, vessel-like structure containing a few pink globules, resembling concentric perivascular layering. Scattered elongated nuclei fill the remaining field. No scale bar or label is printed.
